text:
alex: FYI — billing ops flagged invoice preview variance for a subset of tenants this morning. Preview totals are higher than final by ~1.7% for window 2026-03-14T01:00-04:00 for tenant t-999. Looks correlated to out-of-order session events + late session_end markers.

maya: sounds like the session TTL tweak we shipped last week. Previews do approximate session joins to stay fast, so reorders can cause preview to double-count tokens from overlapping partial sessions.

liam: dug into raw events on shard-3. Found ~2.4k session_ids with events spanning >3m and multiple session_end markers arriving after a gap. Example event ids: e-91a2, e-91a3, e-91b0.

eng-metering-bot: metric spike: ingest.session_reorder_pct for shard-3 jumped 0.4% -> 2.9% between 2026-03-14T01:05Z and 2026-03-14T01:25Z.

zoe: two options: 1) make preview aggregator conservative (close sessions with X buffer) which will reduce variance but increase preview latency; 2) keep fast preview, but surface a "partial session" indicator and add metrics so billing ops understands expected drift; 3) backfill affected final invoices (expensive).

alex: we should minimize user confusion quickly. Plan: (A) add UI badge to invoice preview: "Partial sessions present — totals provisional" + toggle "Hide partial sessions" that applies a conservative filter; (B) emitter metrics from preview: preview_partial_session_fraction and preview_partial_token_pct; (C) schedule small backfill for top-10 impacted tenants after review.

maya: I'll mock the badge and toggle in the console. Also add a small help tooltip explaining why previews can differ from final.

liam: I'll implement the preview tagging in the aggregator. New feature-flag: preview.partial_session_tag. Telemetry will include counts and token-share. Canary deploy to preview cluster planned for 2026-03-14T09:00Z. PR #4310 opened.

eng-metering-bot: auto-created ticket BILL-2233: preview-partial-session-metrics.

alex: alerting: create alert when preview_vs_final_total_delta_pct > 1% sustained for 30m OR preview_partial_session_fraction > 1% for 1h. If fired, page eng-platform + billing-ops.

zoe: UX notes: explain copy: "Previews are computed on approximate session joins for speed. If sessions are still open or arrive out-of-order, totals may change in final invoices. Use 'Hide partial sessions' for conservative totals." Link to runbook and cadence in help.

maya: filing finance ticket with backfill cost estimate: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-2234 (estimate $750 compute).

alex: owners: liam -> aggregator tagging + PR + canary, maya -> console badge + toggle mock, zoe -> help copy and runbook, alex -> alert thresholds and stakeholder comms. Post canary results in this thread.

liam: will post canary metrics and include a small script to compute preview_vs_final deltas for a sample of tenants.

alex: thanks team. Keep billing-ops updated, and remember to flag any tenants that want conservative previews by default. :thumbsup:
